about: Standard test inputs. The same files every night, so results compare across models. Put them in the lab inputs folder on the server.

inputs.use: one person, front view, head and shoulders, plain background
landscape photo with depth and no people
5 s, one person moving or dancing, whole body in frame
5 s, one person talking to camera, with sound
8 s of clear speech, one voice
the fixed prompts: t2i, t2v, i2v, edit, each with a short and a detailed version
